name: Zero Datadog Client Token
description: Neutralizes Datadog analytics log ingestion by zeroing the embedded Datadog client token ('pub'+32 hex) sent as the DD-API-KEY header to https://http-intake.logs.us5.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs. Replace
archive_reason: excluded-by-policy: removes vendor telemetry by zeroing the Datadog token; left to explicit user opt-in, not shipped by default.
